'''Frinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] working for the [[Old Tion Brotherhood]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he worked for [[Gorvich]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] delivering [[Spice/Legends|spice]], but was shot down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the orders of [[Morbo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
